institutions.ripple_coinbase_rlusd: Ripple announced Oct 28 RLUSD trading/management across Coinbase Prime, Exchange and retail, with XRPL/Base/Ethereum rails. Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support was described as future follow-up.
institutions.ripple_bny: BNY announced Oct 27 support for XRP and RLUSD custody; BNY is RLUSD primary reserve custodian. Tokenized trade-finance work with C2FO is exploratory, not confirmed production financing.
institutions.pnc_coinbase_circle: PNC's Nov 9 limited incoming-only pilot uses USDC on Ethereum through Coinbase Payments with 1:1 USD conversion; it is not XRP settlement.
institutions.circle_sbi: Circle and SBI each own 50% of Circle SBI Japan K.K.; Circle controls/consolidates the JV. This is distinct from SBI VC Trade's RLUSD distribution and SBI's Ripple investment.
institutions.sbic_identity: SBIC East/Central/West are separate regional SME investment-development companies, not SBI Holdings. SB OAI Japan is the separate OpenAI/SoftBank JV. SBIC East's official June 12-13 2025 course explicitly covered ChatGPT, Copilot, RAG, APIs and information-leakage risk; this explains a plausible phrase association but is not an OpenAI commercial partnership.
institutions.ripple_national_trust: OCC CAS identifies Ripple National Trust Bank as a national trust-bank charter, approved Dec 12 2025 and consummated/effective Oct 26 2026. This does not by itself establish a full-service deposit bank or XRP settlement demand.
